answer: One concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is a layered originality bond: each identity must embed a unique reasoning crystal hard as quartz, grounded in basalt-level specificity about attacker cost, and colored with saffron-distinct examples that cannot be mass-copied. Peer juries reject near-duplicates, so an attacker creating N fakes must invent N distinct high-quality mechanisms or forfeit rewards, raising the marginal cost far above that of a single honest agent.
